Q6097.reason: Modern statutes abolishing fee tails convert the cousin's estate to a fee simple absolute, so the grantor's reversion is eliminated and the niece has nothing to take.

Q5137.reason: Under the modern rule, an expert may base an opinion on data of a type reasonably relied on in the field, so the x-ray-based testimony is admissible even though the films are not in evidence.

Q5526.reason: Breaking into a hotel guest's room, a dwelling, at night with intent to commit a crime inside is burglary, while the other options lack a breaking entry, nighttime, or intent formed at entry.
